info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Sale Sales Planning-spec
info.description: The Sales Planning Management API facilitates the creation of sales plans within the banking sector. By leveraging this endpoint, users can efficiently submit detailed sales planning specifications to support their sales strategies. Typical consumers include financial institutions and sales teams looking to optimize their planning processes. This API streamlines the submission of essential data for sales forecasting and resource allocation, ultimately enhancing performance and accountability in sales operations.
